question:
In given figure, if BP II CQ and AC = BC, then the measure of x is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37c4c071d5a1ab5e9f294cad62129afed0f13c21a74ca037653ebdeb6435d7e.png]
solution:
**Given:**

∠PBA = 20°

∠Cₑₓₜ = 70°

BP ∥ CQ

AC = BC

**Formula used:**

Exterior Angle Theorem: The exterior angle is equal to the sum of the opposite interior angles.

**Calculation:**

⇒ ∠PBC = ∠Cₑₓₜ = 70° 

⇒ ∠PBC = ∠PBA + ∠ABC

⇒ 70° = 20° + ∠ABC

⇒ ∠ABC = 70 - 20 = 50°

Since, AC = BC, ∠ABC = ∠BAC

∠BAC = 50° 

⇒ ∠Cₑₓₜ + X = ∠ABC + ∠BAC , External Angle theorm

⇒ 70° + X = 50° + 50°

⇒ X = 100° - 70° 

⇒ x = 30°

**∴ The measure of x is 30°.**
